data/three_bucket_summary.csv.description: Main result: three-bucket summary of raw depth per evaluation set, region and tolerance.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Evaluation set: `CG d415`, `CG d435 test`, `CG d435 val` (ClearGrasp real), `TransCG D435`, `TransCG L515`.

fields.name: region
fields.description: `mask` = inside the transparent-object mask; `nonmask` = ClearGrasp control region (TransCG has none, see measurement.md).

fields.name: tol
fields.description: Tolerance: `abs1cm` = 1 cm absolute; `rel5%` = 5% of ground-truth depth.

fields.name: images_with_gt
fields.description: Images with at least one GT-valid pixel in the region.

fields.name: pixels
fields.description: GT-valid pixels counted, summed over images.

fields.name: correct_pooled
fields.description: Percent of pixels with a return within tolerance, pooled over all pixels.

fields.name: missing_pooled
fields.description: Percent of pixels with no return (raw depth = 0), pooled.

fields.name: wrong_pooled
fields.description: Percent of pixels with a return outside tolerance (confidently wrong), pooled.

fields.name: wrong_far_share_pooled
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels whose raw depth is farther than ground truth, pooled.

fields.name: wrong_diff_cm_med
fields.description: Median of raw - GT in cm over wrong pixels, pooled (0.05 cm histogram resolution).

fields.name: wrong_diff_cm_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of raw - GT in cm over wrong pixels, pooled.

data/bias_params_biascorrect.csv.description: Fitted bias model per ClearGrasp image: raw = a*GT + b*x + c*y + d.

fields.name: b_per_px
fields.description: Horizontal gradient, metres per pixel from the image centre.

fields.name: c_per_px
fields.description: Vertical gradient, metres per pixel from the image centre.

fields.name: d_cm
fields.description: Offset at the image centre, cm.

fields.name: tilt_cm
fields.description: Plane gradient across the image, cm.

fields.name: bias_rms_cm
fields.description: RMS of fitted model minus GT over the fit pixels, cm. The reliable size of the bias.

data/object_proxy.csv.description: Per-object consequence proxy: how far the median returned depth of each transparent object is from ground truth. Analysis only; not a grasping experiment.

fields.name: objects
fields.description: Connected components of the GT transparent mask of at least 200 pixels.

fields.name: objects_with_return
fields.description: Objects with enough returned GT-valid pixels to take a median (at least 20; see object_proxy.py).

fields.name: no_return_pct
fields.description: Percent of objects without enough returned pixels: a visible failure.

fields.name: mostly_missing_pct
fields.description: Percent of objects with fewer than half of their GT-valid pixels returned.

fields.name: off_gt2cm_pct
fields.description: Percent of objects with a return whose median raw - GT error exceeds 2 cm in magnitude.

fields.name: off_gt5cm_too_far_pct
fields.description: Percent of the objects off by more than 5 cm whose error reads too far.

fields.name: median_abs_err_cm
fields.description: Median over objects with a return of |median raw - GT|, cm.

fields.name: median_signed_err_cm
fields.description: Median over objects with a return of the signed median raw - GT, cm (positive = too far).

data/models_summary.csv.description: Raw sensor and model outputs scored with the same three buckets.

fields.name: model
fields.description: `raw`; `A_rel_aligned`, `A_rel_local` (Depth Anything V2 Small relative, global / ring alignment); `A_metric` (metric-indoor, as is); `A_metric_aligned`, `A_metric_local`; `B_dfnet` (TransCG DFNet).

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Evaluation set; TransCG rows are split into `(test scenes)`, `(train scenes)` and `(all sampled)`.

fields.name: missing
fields.description: Percent missing, pooled (about 0 for dense models).

fields.name: wrong_far_share
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels reading farther than ground truth.

fields.name: err_cm_med
fields.description: Median of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

data/models_transitions.csv.description: Where each raw-sensor bucket ends up after a model.

fields.name: raw_bucket
fields.description: Bucket of the pixel in the raw sensor: `correct`, `missing`, `wrong`.

fields.name: model_bucket
fields.description: Bucket of the same pixel in the model output.

fields.name: pct_of_raw_bucket
fields.description: `pixels` as a percent of all pixels in `raw_bucket`.

fields.name: still_too_far_pct
fields.description: For wrong -> wrong: percent of those pixels where the model also reads farther than ground truth.

data/models_alignment.csv.description: Quality of the per-image scale+shift fit used for Depth Anything V2.

fields.name: ref_rmse_cm_med
fields.description: Median over images of the RMSE of aligned depth against GT on the fit pixels, cm.

fields.name: frac_nonpositive_slope
fields.description: Fraction of images whose fitted slope was zero or negative.

data/flagging_summary.csv.description: Can the ClearGrasp mask-segmentation network flag the confidently wrong pixels?

fields.name: mask_iou_pooled
fields.description: Mask intersection-over-union against the GT mask, pooled, percent.

fields.name: pred_coverage_vs_gt
fields.description: Predicted mask area as a percent of GT mask area.

fields.name: wrong_px_in_gt_mask_pct
fields.description: Percent of raw confidently wrong pixels that lie inside the GT mask.

fields.name: flag_recall_in_gt_mask
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels inside the GT mask that fall in the predicted mask.

fields.name: flag_recall_all_wrong
fields.description: Percent of all raw confidently wrong pixels that fall in the predicted mask.

fields.name: correct_px_flagged_pct
fields.description: Percent of correct raw pixels that the predicted mask would discard.

fields.name: flagged_returned_px_wrong_pct
fields.description: Percent of flagged pixels that returned a depth and are wrong.

data/synth_vs_real.csv.description: Simulated sensors (uncalibrated settings) against real results.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Evaluation set or synthetic set with its scene count.

fields.name: wrong_far_share
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels that read farther than ground truth.

fields.name: err_cm_med
fields.description: Median of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

fields.name: err_cm_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

data/calibration_targets.csv.description: Real targets of the calibration sets, computed before any search.

fields.name: wrong_far_share
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels that read farther than ground truth.

fields.name: err_cm_med
fields.description: Median of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

fields.name: err_cm_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

data/calibration_search.csv.description: Every grid-search setting and its calibration loss.

fields.name: texture_min
fields.description: Stereo: minimum local IR contrast (9x9 standard deviation).

fields.name: correct
fields.description: Percent correct on the simulated calibration scenes.

fields.name: loss
fields.description: Calibration loss in percentage points: |correct - real| + |missing - real| + |wrong - real|.

fields.name: opaque_correct
fields.description: Stereo only: percent correct on opaque-twin renders (must be at least 98).

fields.name: valid
fields.description: True when the setting satisfies the opaque-twin constraint.

data/calibration_heldout.csv.description: Held-out evaluation after the calibration parameters were frozen.

fields.name: pair
fields.description: Real held-out set the row is compared with.

fields.name: wrong_far_share
fields.description: Percent of wrong pixels that read farther than ground truth.

fields.name: err_cm_med
fields.description: Median of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

fields.name: err_cm_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of output - GT in cm over wrong pixels.

fields.name: loss_vs_real
fields.description: Simulated rows only: sum of absolute differences of correct, missing and wrong against the real row, percentage points.

data/fov_check.csv.description: Sensitivity of D415-like results to the horizontal field of view.

fields.name: hfov_deg
fields.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

data/configs/sgbm.json.description: Frozen OpenCV SGBM settings of the stereo simulator.

fields.name: num_disp
fields.description: Disparity range in pixels per variant (`d415`, `d435`).

data/configs/calibrated.json.description: Calibration parameters frozen before the held-out evaluation.

fields.name: stereo.calibration_loss
fields.description: Loss on the calibration set, percentage points.

fields.name: stereo.uncalibrated_loss
fields.description: Loss of the original settings on the same set.

fields.name: tof.calibration_loss
fields.description: Loss on the calibration set, percentage points.

fields.name: tof.uncalibrated_loss
fields.description: Loss of the original settings on the same set.

data/pose_check_output.txt.description: Console output of `tools/checks/check_transcg_pose.py`: ratio of ground-truth depth to projected object-pose depth, used to verify the TransCG depth units.

examples/sample/<sensor>/<seed>/meta.jso.description: Scene description of a sample scene.

fields.name: baseline
fields.description: Stereo baseline in metres; null for the ToF variant.

fields.name: camera_dist
fields.description: Camera distance from the scene centre, metres.

fields.name: wall
fields.description: Whether a backdrop wall is present.

fields.name: objects
fields.description: Transparent objects: `model` (ClearGrasp 3D model file) and `plastic` (clear plastic instead of glass).
